Feature · Personal Change Management Strategist

Turning Possibilities into Impact

“You have more choices than you think.”

Fondy Foong is at the top of her game. With over 20 years in human resources and operations, she has built effective internal teams across Malaysia and abroad — from small enterprises to large organisations — and supervised teams at every level, including executive management.

A results-driven leader with strong strategic planning, her expertise lies in developing effective teams, and coaching and mentoring those teams — and individuals — to success. Mindset · People · Purpose · Performance.

FAQ

Good Questions

What is the 5Cs Framework™?

Calling, Character, Clarity, Commitment and Contribution — Fondy's signature foundation to help you live out your passion and purpose. It runs through her coaching, training and her book.

Who is coaching with Fondy for?

Professionals in transition, emerging and senior leaders, and anyone who feels stuck and wants clarity on their next chapter.

Does Fondy provide corporate training?

Yes — soft-skills and leadership programmes such as DISC, MBTI, presentation skills, time management, business communication and team building, for organisations of all sizes.

Can I invite Fondy to speak at my event?

Absolutely. Fondy is a TEDx and conference speaker. Share your event date, audience and theme through the contact form.

How do I get the book “Do I Have a Choice?”

Send a message through the contact section or the chat assistant and Fondy's team will guide you to the book.

Are sessions available online?

Yes. Coaching is available online and in person in Kuala Lumpur. Training can be delivered on-site or virtually. ❓
